qlik-principal.description: Following Qlik's acquisition of Talend, continued as Principal Software Engineer within the same organisation, now integrated into Qlik's broader ecosystem of cloud analytics solutions.

talend-principal.description: Evolved into the Principal Software Engineer role at Talend. Took ownership of frontend architecture topics, mentored the team, and contributed to the quality and stability of the TMC product.

talend-senior.description: Joined Talend — a worldwide provider of cloud data management solutions — as a Frontend Developer, quickly progressing to Senior Frontend Developer. This experience was the opportunity to put into practice everything learned before, within the TMC project: driving large features, reducing production risks, and improving team collaboration.

infotel.description: Joined Infotel, an IT services company, as a Fullstack Developer. Worked exclusively for one client — Bureau Veritas — across multiple projects. This experience marked a turning point towards frontend development, with projects built using Angular and Ionic.

steria-tamaris.description: Technical lead on the TAMARIS project for ERDF — a field activity planning application (Flex rich client + PDA client). Coordinated the Paris → Nantes team migration and evolved from Team Leader to Deputy Project Manager and MCO Project Manager, before stepping back to a technical lead role to focus on development.

steria-pole-emploi.description: Short mission on the GUPPI application for Pôle Emploi — a job offer repository management system built with a proprietary MDA framework. Onboarded new team members and contributed to a consultation module rewrite.

steria-ministere.role: Software Engineer — Ministry of the Interior
steria-ministere.description: Application maintenance and support (TMA) for the French Ministry of the Interior across 4 applications (ACTES, ELOI, FNAEG, AGRIPPA). Started as a developer, then grew into application owner and Nantes team lead (6 people).

iminfo.description: Developer and trainer at a 5-person Java software company. Delivered training sessions (Java, jQuery), wrote educational materials, and contributed to a Faiveley Transport project for reading and analysing train black boxes.

seo.description: Professional background of Sébastien Lemouillour — Principal Software Engineer with over 15 years of experience in frontend development.
